items.title: Gayle King learns the Clancy holdout juror was Black
items.summary: On CBS Mornings, Clancy juror Paula Devlin told Gayle King that the lone holdout, who voted guilty, was the jury's only person of color. King's reply, "I have to sit with that for just a second," made her trend.
items.author: @CurtisHouck

post.name: Curtis Houck
post.text:
